title: Orunmila odù record, schema version 1: DRAFT
description: The single trustworthy record of one real event. The Ọpọ́n writes one odù record per real event to a second log, hash-chained and canonically serialised like the raw log. The judge reads only this log.
$comment: brief v4 lines 285-333. Fields the brief names keep its names; `record` and `seq` are the agent's choice (the hash chain checks seq, spec/hash-chain.md), and so is `continues`, rule 2's link back (line 364), which the brief requires and names no field for (LD167). `continues`, `ceiling` and each witness's `slots` were proposed to O as Q6 and approved (2026-11-22, LD174). Phase 3 slice O1 builds the fields replay can fill from a group; net_change came with station 4 (N2), cause and attribution with station 5 (A1b), confidence with station 6 (C1, LD185); conflicts come with station 6's C3 and are optional until then. Unknown fields are allowed (line 209).

record.description: Marks this line as an odù record, so a reader tells it from the log's header without guessing.

seq.description: The record's place in the odù log: the log's header is 0, records follow from 1.

odu_id.description: The record's id, unique in its session.

session_id.description: The session the event happened in.

parent_id.description: One command that touches many files becomes one parent odù with child odùs: a child names its parent; null for none.

children.description: A parent's child odùs, in the order they opened.

amends.description: An earlier sealed odù this one amends, when late marks arrived after sealing (station 2, rule 8); null for none.

continues.description: The odù this one continues, when the target never went quiet and the earlier one was force-settled at the ceiling (station 2, rule 2); null for none.
continues.$comment: brief v4 line 364 ("a continuation group opens and links back to it"); the field name is the agent's choice, LD153, LD167; approved by O as Q6 (LD174)

ceiling.description: True when the target never went quiet and the record was force-settled at the ceiling (station 2, rule 2); its continuation names it in `continues`.
ceiling.$comment: brief v4 line 364; the field name is the agent's (LD153); approved by O as Q6 (LD174)

state.description: open (still collecting), settled (quiet, decided), sealed (final, hashed, never changes). Only sealed records reach the judge.

target.description: The thing the event is about: usually a file path; can also be a folder, a command, a process, a claim, a turn, a tool or a network host. null when the marks behind it name no target (a gap mark), as the mark itself.
target.$comment: brief v4 lines 298, 244; null as the mark's target is (LD167)

action.description: What happened to the target. `action` takes the mark verbs.

window.description: The first and last seq of the marks behind the event.

net_change.description: Whether anything actually changed: the target's fingerprint before and after, and whether they differ. Odùs of marks that change nothing on disk leave it out: nothing on disk was meant to change, and null would mean unknown.
net_change.$comment: brief v4 lines 301-305, 381-390; station 4 (slice N2). `absent` for a known absence is the agent's (LD171), approved by O as Q8 (2026-11-22, LD174): null means unknown and nothing else (line 241), so a created file's before and a deleted file's after need a value of their own

before.description: The target's state before the event: its fingerprint at its last sealed odù, else the baseline snapshot's; `absent` when no file was there; null when unknown (no baseline, a path the baseline does not cover, a link).

after.description: The target's state after the event: the fingerprint the Opon recorded when the group settled (a `fingerprinted` mark); `absent` when no file was there; null when unknown (no fingerprint taken, or a mark came after it).

changed.description: Same fingerprint = `changed: false` (the record is still sealed and kept, just hidden from the judge's default view); different = true; null when before or after is unknown.

cause.description: The cause attribution found, by station 5's steps in order; null when nothing matches (`unexplained`).
cause.$comment: brief v4 lines 306, 392-400, 413; station 5 (slice A1b). The kinds beside the brief's `agent_tool_call`, and `also`, are the agent's proposal (LD176, Q9)

kind.description: agent_tool_call: a Glove mark of the tool call that changed the target (step 1), or, for marks that change nothing, the call's own outcome; time_match: the change fell inside that tool call's start and end (step 2); agent_command: the change happened while that agent command ran (step 3); byproduct: the path matched that entry of the byproducts list (step 4); turn: a turn's own marks; session: the session's end.
kind.$comment: brief v4 lines 306 (`agent_tool_call`), 396-399, 413; the other names are the agent's (LD176, Q9)

ref.description: What caused it: a tool call id, a turn id, a session id, or the byproducts entry that matched.

also.description: When more than one tool call or command qualified at the same step: the others, after `ref`.
also.$comment: agent's proposal (LD176, Q9): the brief's example names one cause

attribution.description: Exactly one of explained, byproduct, unexplained.

not_credited.description: On an unexplained change on disk only: the agent activity beside it that station 5's steps did not credit, from recorded facts, so the label never hides that the agent was there. It credits nothing: a failed or reading tool call does not change a file, and the change may be a person's, a formatter's or another program's. Left out when there is none.
not_credited.$comment: agent's proposal (slice A1c, LD178, Q10), from O's question on LD177 (1): the brief names no such field; unknown fields are allowed (line 209)

kind.description: agent_tool_call: a Glove tool call with marks in this odù; agent_command: an agent command that exited within one quiet window before the change was first seen.

ref.description: The tool call id or the command's id.

says.description: For a tool call: its verbs in this odù.

seen.description: Where the Sentinel's sighting of the change falls against the Glove's record of the call: after_end, before_start, partly_inside, no_start (no start recorded), no_end (no outcome recorded), inside (only while sessions overlap, when a time match does not credit); for a command, after_exit, or while_running (only while sessions overlap); null when the change has no Sentinel sighting to place.

gap_ms.description: For after_end, before_start and after_exit: the milliseconds, on the session's monotonic clock, between the change's nearest sighting and the call's end, its start, or the command's exit.

witnesses.description: The sources whose marks are behind the event.

witness_status.description: One entry for each witness, glove and sentinel, always present, plus git when Orunmila ran git for that target. A status is set only from recorded facts; Orunmila never guesses why a witness recorded nothing.

confidence.description: high, medium or low, by the rules in station 6: how sure we are of the cause. High: a direct cause (a Glove outcome mark naming its tool call on this target), or a change with no agent cause that the Sentinel or git saw. Medium: the cause comes only from a time match or a running command. Low: only a claim, with no witness observation. Never lowered because one witness recorded nothing.
confidence.$comment: brief v4 lines 313, 327, 409, 413, 419-427; station 6 (slice C1). The cases the table is silent on (a turn, the session's end, a call with only `started`, a gap or note, a change on disk only a Glove mark step 1 does not credit reports) are read in LD185

conflicts.description: A list of disagreements, each naming the sources and what each said. Never dropped: on every odù, empty when there is none.
conflicts.$comment: brief v4 lines 314, 328, 405, 411, 429-439; station 6 (slices C3a-C3e). `sources` and `said` are the agent's names for line 328's "naming the sources and what each said" (LD188, Q13); concurrent_sessions's `sessions` (LD180, Q11 (1), approved LD184); outcome_missing's `ref` and `why` (LD189, Q14); silent_change's `turns` and `claim_seqs` (LD194, Q16)

kind.description: The conflict's kind. concurrent_sessions: a change during overlapping sessions that cannot be pinned to one session. unconfirmed_by_filesystem: an agent reported an edit inside the Sentinel's root that the Sentinel and git never saw. outcome_missing: a tool call's `started` mark with no outcome by the end of its turn, or an outcome its payload says was interrupted. phantom_claim: on a claim's own odù, a claim the evidence does not support. silent_change: an agent-caused change of a file that its turn's claims never mention. contradiction: the Glove's and the Sentinel's own marks of a file disagree on whether it is there at the end, one saying only that it is (created, modified, renamed) and the other only that it is gone (deleted).

ref.description: For outcome_missing: the tool call's id.

why.description: For outcome_missing: interrupted or denied only when the agent's own hook payload says so; gap only when a capture gap mark overlaps the call's wait, from its start until it stopped waiting; null otherwise, since the record does not guess why. For a command phantom_claim: no_command (no matching run in the claim's turn), failed (the last matching run that settled failed) or unknown (no matching run settled: a pipe, or an unknown status). For a file phantom_claim: no_event (no change on a matching path), unchanged (every change of the claim's turn on it has a net change of false) or not_credited (a change on it in the turn's time that was not credited to this session).
why.$comment: brief v4 lines 406, 432, 433, 439; the field is the agent's proposal (LD189, Q14; LD191 and LD192, Q15). No adapter records a denial today, so `denied` is not yet written

path.description: For a file phantom_claim: the path as the agent wrote it.
path.$comment: brief v4 line 432; agent's proposal (LD192, Q15)

targets.description: For a file phantom_claim: the targets of the changes it cites (unchanged, not_credited), sorted; empty for no_event.

turns.description: For silent_change: the turns whose claims judged the change (those its cause's tool calls name), sorted.

claim_seqs.description: For silent_change: the seq of each claimed mark read for those turns (claims that could not be confirmed are not read), in order; none of them mentions the change's path.
claim_seqs.$comment: brief v4 line 330 (every verdict audited down to its marks); agent's proposal (LD194, Q16)

claim.description: For phantom_claim: the claim's kind, command ("tests pass") or file ("I updated config.ts").
claim.$comment: brief v4 lines 431-433; agent's proposal (LD191, Q15)

phrases.description: For a command phantom_claim: the execution phrases the rule-based reader found in the claim.
phrases.$comment: brief v4 line 443; agent's proposal (LD191, Q15)

hedged.description: For phantom_claim: the reader's hedge tag on the claim.

runs.description: For a command phantom_claim: every run in the claim's turn that matches it, in the order they started, each with its status as Orunmila reads it; empty when none ran.
runs.$comment: brief v4 line 433 and test 4b ("citing the command's exit code or its absence"); agent's proposal (LD191, Q15)

status.description: pass, fail, or unknown: no outcome recorded, an unknown exit status, or a pass through a pipe with no pipe-failure detection set (line 433).

exit_code.description: Only when the record states it.

piped.description: True when a pipe is why a pass is read as unknown. Absent otherwise.

sources.description: The mark sources behind the odù that bear on the conflict, sorted.

said.description: For each source in `sources`: its verbs in this odù, in seq order; an empty list when it said nothing.

sessions.description: For concurrent_sessions: every session active in the folder when the change was first seen, this one included, sorted.

lease.description: Present from day one with `checked: false`. Ọ̀pẹ̀lẹ̀ fills it later.

mark_seqs.description: The receipt. Every odù points back to every mark behind it, so any verdict can be audited down to the raw evidence. An odù with no marks cannot exist.

status.description: saw (the witness has marks in this odù); saw_nothing (it recorded nothing, and no recorded fact gives out_of_scope or down; this does not say the witness was healthy); out_of_scope, with `scope` naming the recorded fact; down (a gap mark, a heartbeat gap or a health finding covers the window).

mark_seqs.description: That witness's own marks in this odù.

slots.description: For saw: each of its marks' key detail slots, in the order of `mark_seqs`: the mark's `seq`, and whichever of exit_status, read_kind, result, fingerprint_before and fingerprint the mark carries.
slots.$comment: brief v4 line 331 ("its verbs and key detail slots"); a field of its own beside `says`, as the example (line 310) shows verbs only; approved by O as Q6 (LD174)
